display_label: SSC CGL 2026 syllabus baseline — used for 2027 preparation
status_note: The project owner approved the 2026 baseline for 2027 preparation. This is a project working decision, not evidence that SSC has published or confirmed a 2027 syllabus.

tiers.name: Tier-I
tiers.language: English and Hindi, except English Comprehension
notes: For candidates eligible for a scribe under notice paragraphs 7.1–7.3: 1 hour 20 minutes total, with 20 minutes per subject.

tiers.name: Tier-II · Paper-I

sections.name: Section-II · English Language and Comprehension
sections.section_time_note: Section-II total is 60 minutes for English Language and Comprehension plus General Awareness; the notice does not assign separate subject timers here.

sections.name: Section-II · General Awareness
sections.section_time_note: Section-II total is 60 minutes for English Language and Comprehension plus General Awareness; the notice does not assign separate subject timers here.

sections.name: Section-IV · Data Entry Speed Test (DEST)
sections.description: One data-entry task; approximately 2,000 key depressions in 15 minutes, as stated in the notice.

tiers.negative_marking: 1 mark per wrong answer in Sections I, II and III; DEST is a skill test, not an MCQ section.
notes: Paper-I is conducted in two sessions on the same day.
Each section must be qualified separately. Computer Knowledge Test and DEST are qualifying in nature; post-specific higher standards may apply.
Section-I (Mathematical Abilities + Reasoning): 60 questions / 180 marks in 60 minutes, with 30 minutes per subject.
Section-II (English Language and Comprehension + General Awareness): 70 questions / 210 marks in 60 minutes total.
Section-III Computer Knowledge Test: 20 questions / 60 marks in 15 minutes. Section-IV DEST is a qualifying skill test.

tiers.name: Tier-II · Paper-II · Statistics
tiers.applicability: Only candidates who apply and are shortlisted for Junior Statistical Officer or Statistical Investigator Grade-II posts, as specified in the notice.

tiers.name: Tier-II · Paper-III · General Studies (Finance and Economics)
tiers.applicability: Only candidates shortlisted for Assistant Audit Officer / Assistant Accounts Officer posts, as specified in the notice.
